verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an HTTP batch endpoint that submits multiple events in one request, and syncs push entire model results (only changed rows via CDC) to destinations in bulk. Git Sync and the REST API let users manage workspace resources programmatically, so multi-resource changes are possible through scripting. Missing for 10: documented bulk actions over many syncs, models or audiences in the UI, API or MCP (e.g. bulk edit, trigger or delete), batch semantics in the REST API, and hands-on corroboration.
